jobs.occupation: Chauffeur at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Chauffeur to join the Executive Office.

The job holder operates safely a fully armored vehicle to transport the Ambassador and Deputy Chief of Mission within the city and the surrounding areas. Reacts defensively in response to potential security threat-related situations. Analyses the daily appointment schedule, ensuring familiarity with both a primary and alternate route to the destination, as well as potential security concerns at destination.

EXPERIENCE: 3 years of professional driving.

DRIVER'S LICENSE C

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Data Consultant, you are more than just an executor. You are a cornerstone of our Data & AI Business Unit - technically strong, but also driven to improve your colleagues, clients, and our approach every day.

Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.

• You think both customer- and future-oriented: how can we deliver value today and be ready for tomorrow?

• You actively work on your own growth, but also help colleagues grow - through coaching, feedback, or knowledge sharing.

• You have a clear consultancy mindset: supported by (inter)national knowledge, references, and experience, you help our clients reach the next level. You are solution-oriented and leave every client smarter. You work with a partner mindset.

• You take initiative beyond projects to help build Inetum: in client development, talent growth, or community engagement - depending on your strengths.

What we expect from a Consultant

We are looking for someone who recognizes themselves in this profile:

• You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics projects.

• A good knowledge of Dutch and English are mandatory, French is an asset.

• You are familiar with the Azure stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Storage, Purview, Functions) and/or Databricks.

• You think structurally and flexibly: you adapt easily to changing contexts and always seek value for the client.

• You are interested in AI and the role it plays in modern data products (prompt engineering, GenAI, monitoring, automation...).

• You create business impact and understand the outcomes of our work, not just the technical implementations.

• You want to be part of a team - not just participate, but help shape it.

Why join inetum?

• Impactful Career Growth: Work on strategic projects that shape the digital landscape of the public sector.

• Continuous Learning & Development: Access training and certification programs to expand your skills and stay ahead in the industry.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid working options, satellite offices, and a dynamic work environment.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, company car, fuel/charging card, group insurance, hospitalization coverage, and 32 days of annual leave.

• Global Reach with Local Expertise: Be part of an international company with strong local market presence.

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.
